{3: 'The sun blazes overhead, pouring down on the ruins like a floodlight with nowhere to hide. And yet, a Construct creeps low through the space, slipping between the narrow shadows cast by the crumbling remains.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory870.jpg'}
{3: 'Kronos has survived the explosion, shielded from the worst of the blast by a hazmat container stored in the warehouse.'}
{3: '为了保障内容物以及危机状态下外界不会受到影响，这些运输箱从头到尾都使用了特制的工艺，跟随豪尔赫很久的她深知这点。'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "The Corrupted aren't following anymore...", 4: '1'}
{3: "She may have cheated death, but the Ascendant has no intention of leaving survivors. Swarms of Corrupted fan out across the ruins under the Ascendant's orders, hunting for anyone still alive."}
{3: 'With nowhere to run, Kronos squeezes into a narrow, hollow space beneath the rubble and stays still, waiting until the sounds of the Corrupted slowly fade into the distance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "Amazigh... The Ascendant's real target is Ytterbium-174. That's the only thing that would need a specialized cryo-container to transport.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kronos', 3: 'And no matter how capable the Ascendant is, she still needs a way to move those two freighters docked on the far bank...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kronos', 3: "Those two freighters have no place in this operation. They have to be the Ascendant's.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'After watching from the shadows for a while and confirming her targets, Kronos turns her mind to what comes next.'}

{3: 'The reason she had requested leave to come here in the first place was to stop Jorge before everything fell apart. She wanted to make him see his mistake and turn himself in before it was too late.'}
{3: 'But with everything in the warehouse reduced to ash, that option is off the table.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'Make it right... Let me take out those two freighters.', 4: '1'}
{3: "The Ascendant's comms blackout has cut her off from the outside world, but this is far from an issue for someone about to join the Engineering Force."}
{2: 'Kronos', 3: 'You can do this, Kronos.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She curls her fist tight. For a moment, her mind flashes to Jorge and the siblings she grew up with back on Babylonia, and the resolve already burning in her chest grows stronger.'}
{3: 'But she is barely out of the wreckage she has been hiding in when she realizes she has underestimated how complicated things have gotten.'}
{3: 'The horde of Corrupted has not left. Like her, they have been hiding beneath the rubble, lying perfectly still and waiting for the moment she steps out and gives herself away.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'That sneaky Ascendant!', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: "Kronos' grip tightens on her lance as her eyes sweep the area. Twisted bodies drag themselves out from under the broken stone one by one, and dozens of them are closing in from every direction within moments."}

{3: "She knows this area was created by the Ascendant, but even so, she never imagined that a place under Babylonia's logistical operations could be crawling with this many Corrupted under the Ascendant's command."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'How many can I take down... three? No. I have to get at least five if I want to make an opening... but will I have enough strength left to make it to the freighters?', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The Corrupted tighten the circle with their coiled limbs, every one of them poised to lunge. Kronos runs through every tactic she has learnt, desperately combing her memory for anything that might get her out of this.'}
{3: 'Finally, she draws a deep breath and levels her lance at the Corrupted.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'I refuse to die here. I am not dying here!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'This is her last resort, the one move everyone makes: pray for a miracle.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'Just before the fight breaks out, a sharp buzzing sound cuts through the air, and both Kronos and the Corrupted turn toward it at once.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Kronos looks up. A scorched alloy panel drifts through the air, trailing faint flames and black smoke. Standing firmly on it is a Construct in a distinctly unusual attire.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory995.jpg'}
{3: "Her long-range vision module snaps into focus, and she catches every movement of the Construct's lips with perfect clarity."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The words are barely formed when the figure crouches and coils, rocketing off the falling panel like a missile straight toward Kronos before she can even react.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{3: 'The crash sends a shockwave outward, blasting the surrounding Corrupted off their feet. Before any of them can recover, Leia is already launching her attacks.'}
{3: 'Some are hurled into each other like living projectiles, while others get caught in the blast as their kin explode.'}
{3: "Some are shattered outright by Leia's strikes. More lose their footing and tumble back down into the holes beneath the wreckage, never to crawl out again."}
{3: 'In mere moments, the swarm of Corrupted that surrounded Kronos is torn apart.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "What's going on?!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Hm? I'm saving you, obviously.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: "That's not what I meant... I want to know why you came crashing down from the sky!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'With the threat gone as quickly as it came, Kronos almost finds herself thinking the silent prayer she made came true, even though she knows better than that.'}
{1: '14', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Well, the best way to find someone is from up high. And if there's no high ground, you just have to make your own.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Luckily, there were still some hazardous materials in the warehouse that weren't destroyed. I just didn't expect a little spark to send me flying so high—", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: 'Leia! Are you okay?!', 4: '18'}

{3: 'The roar of an engine cuts through the air, growing louder by the second as Sylph tears through the rubble in the transport vehicle. Kronos catches a familiar face in the passenger seat, and her heart skips a beat.'}

{3: 'The vehicle screeches to a halt. Jorge practically stumbles out before it even stops, rushing to the frozen Kronos and holding her hands. He gently caresses her face, repeatedly checking her for any sign of injury.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: "Kronos... it's really you, isn't it?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kronos', 3: 'Dad... what are you doing here?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: 'To rescue you! I thought you were...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "You foolish child! If you'd made it out alive, you should have just fled back to base! What were you thinking, trying to blow up the freighters?!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kronos', 3: '...How did you know what I was planning?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Jorge', 3: "That's all thanks to Leia. She was how we found you too!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "That's right. Leia recalled the cryo-containers from Jorge's memories and figured those two freighters must have some connection to the Ascendant.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sylph', 3: "And if you're the kind of headstrong daughter who'd do anything for her father... there was really only one thing you'd do.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Am I right, or am I right?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sylph', 3: "You're not wrong... but rushing in headfirst is never a good idea.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Mid-conversation, Sylph's voice drops without warning. She turns, one hand moving to the dagger at her hip, and every muscle in her body tenses."}

{3: 'The other three pick up on it at the same moment, and their smiles fade as their eyes sweep the ash-gray ruins around them. The air still reeks of burnt chemicals, so thick that their frames feel heavy.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kronos', 3: 'Hey, look at the Corrupted...!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFireLiziNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The Corrupted strewn across the ground begin to ignite. Tongues of open flame sprout from the wreckage out of nowhere.'}
{3: 'This is no short circuit. The flames start at the most prominent parts of each Corrupted before they spread like wildfire, one after another.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Immediately, every Corrupted Leia took down becomes fuel for the flames. The fire surrounds the group from all sides, sealing them in a wall of flame.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "These flames, Mr. Jorge... Don't tell me...?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Jorge', 3: "That's right... it's Amazigh, aargh—!", 4: '1'}
{3: '话音刚落，豪尔赫的机体表层毫无征兆窜起烈火，高温瞬间啃噬外层衣服，合金手臂下的保护层极速汽化，外露出的金属也迅速焦糊发黑——'}
{3: 'Searing pain tears through his neural transmission modules, and Jorge cries out a broken, involuntary sound before crashing hard to the ground.'}
{3: "Desperate as the situation is, only Kronos throws herself forward, beating at the flames on Jorge's body with her bare hands, smothering them wherever they rise."}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "So you've been hiding here all along, Ascendant!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiFubenRogueLike/FxUiFubenRogueLike01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Leia does not join Kronos, as she can sense the gaunt, menacing figure lurking beyond the wall of fire and radiating a suffocating malice.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'From behind the flames comes a scornful laugh, and then the figure steps forward.'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The dancing flames illuminate her dark brown skin, yet never touch her. Amazigh steps through the wall of fire without so much as flinching, entering the hunting ground she herself has created.'}

{3: 'Her dark gold eyes sweep across the four insignificant Constructs with cold indifference, and the corner of her lips curls into a chilling smile. Then, deliberate and unhurried, she pronounces her verdict.'}
{2: 'Amazigh', 3: 'Your detective game ends here, Babylonia.', 4: '2'}
